full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos. 5-10 contested the suit by filing written statements denying the material allegations of the plaint and contended infer alia that the suit as framed is not maintainable in law. It was also contended that the suit is barred by limitation and it is bad for defect of parties. It was also alleged that the plaintiffs have no title and possession in the suit property.
